disclaimer: Unofficial community library. Not affiliated with or endorsed by bKash Limited.

levels.stable: Verified against the published documentation and covered by automated tests.
levels.beta: Covered by automated tests and, where noted, a live sandbox run. Not yet validated end to end with a real payment.
levels.experimental: Implemented and tested against mocks only. May change.

features.name: Tokenized Checkout v1.2.0-beta
features.description: Grant token, create, execute, query, search, refund and refund status against /v1.2.0-beta.
features.evidence: automated tests against a local mock; live sandbox create+query run on 2026-10-27 (execute needs a customer PIN and is NOT TESTED live)

features.name: Tokenized Checkout v2
features.description: Grant/refresh token, create, execute, query, search, refund and refund status on /v2/tokenized-checkout, following developer.bka.sh.
features.evidence: automated tests against a strict mock of the documented paths and fields; NOT TESTED against the live v2 sandbox

features.name: Token cache, refresh and lock
features.description: Reuses the id_token, refreshes before expiry and shares it across instances so Grant/Refresh stay within the documented two-calls-per-hour limit.
features.evidence: automated tests (concurrency, lease expiry); real Redis tests run in CI

features.name: Amount and invoice verification
features.description: Rejects an execute result whose amount, currency or invoice differs from the order you expected.
features.evidence: automated tests

features.name: Timeout and 2062 reconciliation
features.description: On a 30 s timeout or error 2062, queries the payment and reports Completed, or an explicit unknown outcome.
features.evidence: automated tests against a mock

features.name: Web-standard HTTP handler
features.description: /create, /callback, /status and /webhook. The server decides amount and invoice; callback URLs and redirects are allowlisted; responses are minimal.
features.evidence: automated tests: tampering, allowlist, error mapping

features.name: Documented error-code table
features.description: All 87 payment and refund codes from the published bKash tables mapped to messages.
features.evidence: automated tests compare the table with the published codes

features.name: Agreements (tokenized, v2)
features.description: Create, execute, query and cancel an agreement; create and execute payments with an agreement.
features.evidence: automated tests against a strict mock; NOT TESTED live. Not available with apiVersion v1.2.0-beta.

features.name: Refund and refund status
features.description: Full or partial refund (up to 10 per transaction within 60 days) and refund history.
features.evidence: automated tests; NOT TESTED live

features.name: Search transaction
features.description: Look up a completed transaction by trxId.
features.evidence: automated tests

features.name: IPN / webhook (AWS SNS) verification
features.description: Verifies bKash IPN messages delivered through AWS SNS (certificate host check, signature, replay).
features.evidence: automated tests with generated keys; NOT TESTED with a real bKash notification

features.name: Auth & Capture
features.description: The capture and void endpoints are not in the public bKash documentation, so they are not implemented. Methods throw BkashFeatureNotSupportedError.
features.evidence: Specification not public

features.name: Direct Charge / Linked Apps
features.description: Mentioned in the bKash FAQ; no public API specification.
features.evidence: Specification not public

features.name: Dynamic Charging
features.description: Documented as a product on the bKash demo portal; no public API specification.
features.evidence: Specification not public

features.name: Disbursement, B2B and M2M payouts
